verdict.rationale: Buzz is agent-native chat where agents interact via structured commands, channels, and an MCP/CLI interface (buzz-gh-2, buzz-probe-3, buzz-docs-5/7/8), but the CLI commands shown are structured flags/subcommands rather than natural-language input, and there's no evidence of a conversational NL interface for operating the product. missing for 10: documentation or demo of actual natural-language command parsing/interpretation (vs. structured CLI/MCP calls), independent confirmation that NL commands work in practice.
